en.headline: Order gazetted granting privileges and immunities for Interpol General Assembly
en.dek: The subsidiary legislation implements an agreement between the Central People’s Government and Interpol for the 94th General Assembly and related Executive Committee session in Hong Kong next month.
body: The International Organizations (Privileges and Immunities) (The International Criminal Police Organization-INTERPOL) (231st Executive Committee Session and 94th General Assembly Session) Order was gazetted on Friday.

The Order, made by the Chief Executive in Council under the International Organizations (Privileges and Immunities) Ordinance, implements privileges and immunities agreed between the Central People’s Government and Interpol for the 231st Executive Committee Session on 29 November and the 94th General Assembly from 30 November to 3 December in Hong Kong.
The General Assembly is Interpol’s highest governing body. The Order will be tabled in the Legislative Council on 21 October for negative vetting and is scheduled to come into operation the same day.

zh.headline: 國際刑警組織大會特權及豁免權令刊憲
zh.dek: 有關附屬法例落實中央人民政府與國際刑警組織的協議，適用於下月在港舉行的第94屆全體大會及執委會會議。
body: 《國際組織（特權及豁免權）（國際刑警組織）（第231次執委會會議及第94屆全體大會）令》周五刊憲。
該命令由行政長官會同行政會議根據《國際組織（特權及豁免權）條例》制定，落實中央人民政府與國際刑警組織就第231次執委會會議（11月29日）及第94屆全體大會（11月30日至12月3日）在香港舉行而授予的特權及豁免權。
全體大會是國際刑警組織的最高權力機關。命令將於10月21日提交立法會進行先訂立後審議程序，並於同日生效。
